description: This file defines the Affiliate controller class for handling email notifications related to affiliates within the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It includes methods for sending affiliate registration emails and alert notifications to the store administrators, integrating with the system's models, configuration, and view loading mechanisms.

classes.name: Affiliate
classes.description: Controller class managing affiliate-related email notifications, including registration confirmation and admin alerts.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles sending registration completion email to affiliate customers, preparing email content using language and view templates, and scheduling email tasks.

methods.name: alert
methods.description: Sends alert emails to store administrators when a new affiliate registers, including customer details and website information, utilizing task scheduling.
